criteria.semantics: A native <ul> named by the list's label (aria-label), one native <li> per item.

keyboard.outcome: Passes it by: it is not a stop in the tab order.
Move to the list, and from item to item.

criteria.name: The list's label.
criteria.role: List, with its number of items.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my text size to 200% I SEE the items grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I zoom the page to 400% I SEE the items stack in one column, with no horizontal scrolling.

check.statement: The face emits a native <ul> element.
The list is named by its label in aria-label.
Every item is a native <li>, one per item of the list.
WHEN I reach the list with a desktop screen reader (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) I HEAR its name, the role of list and how many items it has.
WHEN I move through it I HEAR each item, and where the list ends.

criteria.semantics: The list's label, then each item after a bullet (•), in fg on bg; an item that is a link or a control is a stop in the tab order, the list itself is not. GPUI exposes no accessibility tree, so no list role or count reaches assistive technology.

keyboard.outcome: Passes it by: it is not a stop in the tab order.

keyboard.key: Tab (an item that is a link or control)
keyboard.outcome: Focus moves to the item, in document order.

criteria.name: The list's label.
criteria.role: List, with its number of items.

setting.statement: WHEN I set my system text size to 200% I SEE the label and the items grow with it, with no loss of information.
WHEN I magnify the window with the system zoom I SEE the items whole.

check.statement: A list adds no stop of its own to the window's tab order.
I SEE each item set apart by a bullet, not only by spacing.
WHEN I reach the list with a screen reader (VoiceOver, Orca, Narrator) I HEAR its name and how many items it has.

criteria.note: GPUI 0.2.2 exposes no accessibility tree (no AccessKit): every HEAR check fails on this face today. Its SEE checks with a probe run on GPUI's test platform (gpui/src/native.rs), which no CI job runs yet (gpui/README.md, Verification); the rest are reported as not verified.
